description: Resolve a contract-authoring catalog rate by preferring the matching contract-currency price, then falling back to the catalog default rate, while reporting the selected source.
Allow GenericContractLineServicesList to add a service with its catalog default rate when no contract-currency price row exists.
Require a manual rate only when a selected service has neither a contract-currency price nor a usable catalog default rate.
Use the shared authoring-rate resolver in ServiceSelectionDialog so all existing-line membership additions apply the same precedence.
Exclude product catalog items from hourly, usage, and bucket-style service selection while retaining supported fixed-line product selection.
Capture resolved catalog rate metadata for fixed services selected in the contract wizard without changing the persisted submission shape.
Suggest the fixed recurring base rate as the sum of each selected service's resolved rate multiplied by its quantity.
Refresh an auto-derived fixed base-rate suggestion when fixed services are selected, replaced, removed, or have their quantities changed.
Preserve a manually edited, resumed, or existing fixed base rate instead of overwriting it after service-list changes.
Keep the existing non-zero recurring base-rate validation for fixed lines when no positive suggestion can be produced.
Seed an empty legacy fixed-line base-rate editor from the resolved associated-service total without changing a populated value.
Label currency-specific and catalog-default authoring rates accurately without creating or modifying catalog currency-price rows.
